files.description: Club members, one per row (240 rows): member_id (whole number), full_name (first and last name; many names have accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent), home_city (city name, several with accented letters; capital letters and spaces around the name are inconsistent; about 3% of cells are empty and about 3% hold "-" for an unknown city), fee (yearly fee, two decimals).

task_text: Count the members per home city. Write the city names without surrounding spaces and with each word capitalised. Members whose city is empty or '-' are counted under the name 'Unknown'. `result` should be a Series indexed by city name with the member counts, sorted by city name.
intended_computation: Tidy home_city (strip, title case), map empty cells and '-' to 'Unknown', count members per city and sort by city name: 9 labels (8 cities plus Unknown) whose counts add up to 240.

acceptable_variants.notes: any alphabetical collation of the city names is accepted (code-point order or accent-insensitive/locale order)

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the None sentinel becomes NaN, the 'is None' test fails and the unknown members drop out of the counts

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
